{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient is counted once, using the most recent (highest sample_seq) row
deduplicated = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count the number of unique patients
num_patients = len(deduplicated)

# Print the result
print(num_patients)"}
